description: This file defines the internal class 'DynamoDBGatewayListProvider' implementing the 'IGatewayListProvider' interface, responsible for managing and retrieving gateway addresses stored in DynamoDB for Orleans clustering. It includes methods for initializing the storage table and fetching active gateway URIs.

classes.name: DynamoDBGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Internal class implementing IGatewayListProvider, managing gateway list retrieval and storage in DynamoDB.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the DynamoDB storage table with appropriate schema for gateway records.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Retrieves the list of active gateway URIs from DynamoDB based on specific status and deployment criteria.
